item.title: HariKube v0.16.3: Certified on Rancher & OpenShift, K8s 1.36.2 Upgrade, Adaptive Rate Limiting, and Scalable Control Planes
item.description:
Table of Contents

  • 🏷️ Standardized Versioning Scheme (Aligned with Kine)
  • 🤠 Certified on SUSE Rancher & Available in Rancher App Store
  • 🔴 Certified on Red Hat OpenShift
  • 🛡️ Built-in Adaptive Rate Limiter (EWMA)
  • ⚡ Performance Boost: Accelerated Field Selector Filtering
  • ☸️ Upgraded to Kubernetes 1.36.2
  • 📦 Streamlined Helm Deployments & Control Plane Architecture
  • 🚀 Get Started Today

Today, we are taking a massive leap forward in making HariKube the ultimate high-scale state platform for production cloud-native environments.

item.title: Kubernetes Bottleneck is Broken, Development Taxes Are Repealed: Announcing HariKube 1.0
item.description:
Table of Contents

  • 🏋️ The End of the Etcd Bottleneck
  • 🏗️ Repealing the “Development Tax”
  • 🎯 Who is HariKube For?
  • 🚀 The Road to 1.0 and Beyond

For too long, the “Kubernetes Tax” has been a mandatory payment for every engineering team. You pay it in time spent configuring YAML, you pay it in cognitive load trying to understand networking, and you pay it in performance when etcd hits its scaling limit.
